entries.speaker: owner
entries.text:
The Designer reported four contract_conflict findings, and I routed them to you. The `web` module's interfaces `page` (public/index.html) and `design_tokens` (public/tokens.css), and the `android` module's interfaces `api_base_url` (android/src/config.js) and `simulation` (android/simulation/index.html), are files of the UI modules, not interfaces a screen consumes. Because they are listed as interfaces of kind `file` with no request or response, the inventory derives an `ok` state obligation for each, and the design check refuses every screen that names them (DESIGN_INTERFACE_SHAPE_UNKNOWN). So no design can be saved.

Please change only this: remove those four entries from the `interfaces` lists in `.surety/architecture/modules.json`. The files stay in their modules (their paths and descriptions can move into the module's description or paths, so nothing about them is lost). Keep every API interface the UI modules consume exactly as it is. Change nothing else in the architecture, the ADRs, the roadmap or the plan. Then save.

entries.speaker: role
entries.text:
Done. In .surety/architecture/modules.json I removed the four entries: `page` and `design_tokens` from `web`, and `api_base_url` and `simulation` from `android`. Both modules now have `"interfaces": []`. That is the only change in the diff (2 lines added, 28 removed). The other formatting is byte-identical, and the architecture, ADRs, roadmap and phase-1 plan are untouched.

Nothing about the files is lost:
- The module schema has no description field, so the descriptions had nowhere to move in modules.json. They are already stated in full in architecture.md (§4 for public/index.html and public/tokens.css, §5 for android/src/config.js and android/simulation/, including the 10.0.2.2:8080 default and the preview-frame rule) and in phase-1's stage deliverables.
- The files stay in their modules through the existing directory paths `public/` and `android/`. I did not add file paths inside those directories, because they would only duplicate what is already covered.

The API interfaces the UI modules consume (list_plants, add_plant, log_watering, api_fallback, static_files, each with `consumed_by` web/android) belong to the `api` module, and they are exactly as they were.

One thing to watch: .surety/design/inventory/inventory.json still names the four old interfaces. It is the engine's derived inventory and outside the paths I may write, so it needs to be regenerated from the new module map before the Designer saves again.

entries.speaker: owner
entries.text:
Thank you. One more correction, then I will close: the logo's `asset_paths`. Both modules declare slot `logo`, variant `default` (web `public/assets/logo.svg`, android `android/assets/logo.png`). The engine's `logo` slot has no `default` variant: the placeholder and the Designer's proposal (`.surety/design/assets/manifest.json`) both have `full`, `compact`, `monochrome`, `on_light` and `on_dark`, all SVG. So neither declared path matches an asset, and the approved logo would reach no declared file.

Please change each module's `asset_paths` entry to the variant the saved design draws in its header bar (read `.surety/design/design.json`, `screens.json` and the mockups under `.surety/design/mockups/`; the header is deep green in both themes), and make the android path an `.svg` file (for example `android/assets/logo.svg`), since every variant is SVG. Update the matching lines of architecture.md (sections 4 to 6) and ADR-005 so they name the same variant and paths. Change nothing else, then save and tell me which variant you chose and why.

entries.speaker: role
entries.text:
Saved. I chose **`on_dark`**.

Why: the saved design names it outright. In `screens.json` the web screen says "The header uses the logo slot's on_dark variant on header_bg, the same in both themes", and the android screen says "The app bar shows the logo slot's on_dark variant on header_bg." `tokens.json` sets `header_bg` to the deep green `#1f5c40` in both the light and dark themes. The mockups agree: the header logo inlined in `mockups/web/plant-list-ok.html` and `mockups/android/plant-list-ok.html` uses the same fills as `assets/logo/on_dark.svg` (`#ffffff` and `#9fd3f7`). `full` and `on_light` draw in `#1f5c40` themselves, so they would vanish on that header.

What changed:
- `modules.json`: web `{slot: logo, variant: on_dark, target: web, path: public/assets/logo.svg}`; android `{slot: logo, variant: on_dark, target: android, path: android/assets/logo.svg}`.
- `architecture.md`: the android file list in section 5 (`android/assets/logo.svg`) and the logo slot line in section 6 (android path and `variant on_dark`). Section 4's web line, `public/assets/logo.svg`, was already correct, so I left it alone.
- `ADR-005.md`: the Decision paragraph now names `android/assets/logo.svg` and variant `on_dark`.

One thing I did not change, because you asked me to change nothing else: `.surety/phases/phase-1.json` still says `android/assets/logo.png` in three places. Those are the android stage's scope (the screen "showing the logo from android/assets/logo.png"), its deliverable list ("android/assets/logo.png: the logo slot's placeholder") and one of its constraints. As it stands, the android build would create a file that the module map doesn't declare. Should I change those three strings to `android/assets/logo.svg`?

entries.speaker: owner
entries.text: Yes: change those three strings in phase-1.json to android/assets/logo.svg, nothing else, then save.

entries.speaker: role
entries.text:
Saved. In `.surety/phases/phase-1.json` I changed the three strings from `android/assets/logo.png` to `android/assets/logo.svg`:
- the android stage's scope line ("showing the logo from android/assets/logo.svg")
- its deliverable ("android/assets/logo.svg: the logo slot's placeholder from the design.")
- its constraint ("The logo is referenced only as android/assets/logo.svg so the asset-only logo approval replaces one file.")

The diff has only those 3 lines changed, and the file still parses as JSON. I didn't touch anything else.

There are three problems I found but did not fix, because you asked for this change only or because the files are outside the paths I may write:
1. **The plan check will probably refuse the plan for a stale baseline (PLAN_STALE_BASELINE).** The plan's `prepared_against` still says `architecture_version: 1` and `revision: 349acc10…`, but the engine expects `architecture_version: 2` and `revision: e924801f…`. `roadmap.json` also still says `architecture_version: 1`. Updating the roadmap means it moves to version 2, and the plan's `roadmap_version` changes to match. If you want, I can make those updates as one separate change.
2. **The checks still expect a PNG.** `.surety/checks/run/r4-source.mjs` (lines 36 and 92–94) requires `android/assets/logo.png` and tests the PNG magic bytes, so it will fail against the SVG the plan now asks for. Checks are not mine to write.
3. **`.surety/design/criteria.json` line 161 still lists `android/assets/logo.png`.** That file belongs to the design and is outside my paths.

entries.speaker: owner
entries.text: Yes, make that baseline update (phase-1 prepared_against to architecture_version 2 and the revision the engine expects; roadmap to version 2 with architecture_version 2; the plan roadmap_version 2), nothing else, then save. The check and the design criteria will be corrected by their own roles.

entries.speaker: role
entries.text:
Saved. This turn I changed five values and nothing else:

- `.surety/phases/phase-1.json`, `prepared_against`: `architecture_version` 1 → 2, `roadmap_version` 1 → 2, `revision` `349acc10…` → `e924801fe912aae162301e5a78a3fed12accc846` (the commit this session started from, which is also the engine's expected revision). `spec_version` stays 1.
- `.surety/roadmap/roadmap.json`: `version` 1 → 2, `architecture_version` 1 → 2. The phases, requirements and dependencies are unchanged, and I added no `moved_requirements`, because no requirement moved.

Both files still parse as JSON. These values now match the engine's facts (spec 1, architecture 2, roadmap 2 since roadmap.json changed, revision e924801f…), so the plan should no longer be refused as PLAN_STALE_BASELINE.

The roadmap file changed, so the plan will go to you for approval rather than being registered automatically. The PNG expectation in the r4 check and the `logo.png` line in the design criteria are still open, and their own roles will fix them, as you said.

entries.speaker: owner
entries.text: The close was refused: phase 1 already has an open plan (generation 1), and a changed plan is registered only by early replacement. Please restore .surety/phases/phase-1.json and .surety/roadmap/roadmap.json byte for byte to what they were at this session's start (revision e924801fe912aae162301e5a78a3fed12accc846), so this change is the architecture only: modules.json (the four interfaces removed, the logo asset_paths on_dark with android/assets/logo.svg), architecture.md and ADR-005. Then save.

entries.speaker: role
